name: Choong-Moo
meaning: Named after Admiral Yi Soon-Sin of the Yi Dynasty, credited with inventing the armoured battleship (Kobukson) in 1592. The pattern finishes with a left-hand attack, symbolising his death before he could fully display his skill.
